newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor in modest setback, nil fresh interest.
newsitem.headline: India castor in modest setback, nil fresh interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery on Wednesday suffered a modest setback falling to 1,142 rupees from 1,145 rupees on new offerings, dealers said.
"Absence of fresh export enquiries for castoroil induced bull operators to book profit while bears turned active sellers," one dealer said.

Groundnut oil was steady at 349/350 rupees per 10 kg on stray physical enquiries coupled with restricted new arrivals. "Sentiment however was subdued as traders were expecting arrivals of about 3-4,000 tonnes of imported palm oil shortly," one miller said. Rajkot spot oil was steady at 530/535 rupees.
